claimed_title: Fabens, Tex., created a port of entry in Customs Collec tion DistrictNo. 24 (El Paso).
text:
Executive IDtbe?
By virtue of the authority vested in me by the Act of Congress approved
August 1, 1914, making appropriations for the sundry civil expenses of the Govern-
ment for the fiscal year ended June 30, 1915, the customs station of Fabens, Texas,
in customs collection district #24 (El Paso) is hereby created
